title: The Raven and the Fox
subject: English
summary: “The Raven and the Fox” is a story about a clever fox and a foolish raven. One day, a raven found a piece of cheese and sat on a tree branch to eat it. A hungry fox saw the cheese and wanted to get it. The fox thought of a clever plan. He began praising the raven by saying that it was beautiful and had a lovely voice. The raven felt very happy and wanted to sing. As soon as it opened its beak to sing, the piece of cheese fell down. The clever fox quickly picked up the cheese and ran away. The raven realised that the fox had fooled it with sweet words. The story teaches us that we should not believe people who flatter us, because they may be trying to fool us.
